children: Global agricultural commodity merchant Louis Dreyfus Company posted a rise in first-half profits, citing volume growth supported by investments across its supply chain.

LDC said in a statement on Monday that its core earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation reached $1.036 billion in the first six months of 2026 against $987 million in the year-earlier period. Group net profit rose to $444 million from $418 million.
